caseNameFull: Duncan v. Tennessee Little v. Texas Lightbourne v. Dugger, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections Melton v. California Holiday v. Georgia Harrell v. Alabama Smith v. Indiana Dyer v. California Cole v. Mississippi

opinions.text: Ct. Crim. App. Tenn.; Ct. Crim. App. Tex.; C. A. 11th Cir.; Sup. Ct. Cal.; Sup. Ct. Ga.; Ct. Crim. App. Ala.; Sup. Ct. Ind.; Sup. Ct. Cal.; and Sup. Ct. Miss. Certiorari denied.

opinions.author: Brennanmarshall
opinions.text:
Justice Brennan and Justice Marshall,

dissenting.

Adhering to our views that the death penalty is in all circumstances cruel and unusual punishment prohibited by the Eighth and Fourteenth Amendments, Gregg v. Georgia, 428 U. S. 153, 227, 231 (1976), we would grant certiorari and vacate the death sentences in these cases.
